days.title: Colour mixing basics
days.description: Mix primary colours to create secondary colours. Fill a page with colour swatches.
days.tip: Always add dark to light, never light to dark

days.title: Simple shapes
days.description: Paint 5 simple objects: apple, cup, book, ball, leaf. Focus on shape not detail.
days.tip: Squint at your subject — this helps you see shapes instead of details

days.title: Light and shadow
days.description: Paint a single object with a clear light source. Add a highlight and a shadow.
days.tip: The shadow is never just black — add a complementary colour

days.title: Colour harmony
days.description: Paint a small scene using only 3 colours + white.
days.tip: Limiting colours forces you to mix creatively

days.title: Texture experiment
days.description: Try 4 different brush techniques: stippling, cross-hatching, wet-on-wet, dry brush.
days.tip: Load less paint than you think you need

days.title: Paint from a photo
days.description: Choose a simple landscape photo and paint it loosely. Aim for mood, not accuracy.
days.tip: Simplify — paint 3 layers: background, midground, foreground

days.title: Week 1 review
days.description: Line up all your paintings from this week. Pick one to photograph and save.
days.tip: Progress feels slow day to day but dramatic week to week
